name: OpenClaw 网关排错文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw 网关排错文档校验 Capsule
# 验证网关排错文档标题、用途与核心问题分类入口

echo "🔍 抓取网关排错文档..."
curl -s -o ts.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/troubleshooting

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Gateway Troubleshooting" ts.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证端口问题入口..."
grep -q "Port Conflicts" ts.html && echo "port ok" || echo "port fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证认证错误入口..."
grep -q "Authentication Errors" ts.html && echo "auth ok" || echo "auth fail"

# 清理
rm -f ts.html
description: 验证网关排错文档标题、用途与核心问题分类入口 (连接/端口/认证)
expected_output: title ok / port ok / auth ok
